items.text: lib/commands.sh is 1,384 lines with 61 functions and 135 aliases across unrelated domains.
Follow #153's lib module rules for boundaries, size, naming, and load order.
Split into lib/git.sh, lib/npm.sh, lib/docker.sh, lib/tmux.sh by domain; tmux is large (~71 hits).
lib/cloud.sh holds AWS/DigitalOcean/terraform/SSH as one file; don't pre-split terraform/ssh pieces.
lib/repo.sh gets the .gitignore generator (~L712–745) and mkrepo, not the general bucket.
lib/agent.sh gets the Claude keep-alive loop (~L375–388) and related agent-state helpers.
lib/commands.sh keeps only general shell utilities that fit no other module.
lib/index.sh globs lib/*.sh (excluding index.sh), so new files are sourced automatically.
Before splitting, index.sh must explicitly source _*.sh first, with a test; _shared.sh precedes all others.
Under en_US.UTF-8, current glob order sorts _shared.sh 10th of 11, not first.
Each lib/*.sh file at or under ~300 lines by wc -l (soft cap per #153).
Don't change function signatures or alias names; all must still work in a new shell.
Run bashcheck (project linter, not bash -n) on each new file.
